integrity: All anonymous ballot-multiplicity profiles through five voters are exhausted and weighted exactly to labeled profiles. A second explicit-ballot implementation independently replays both elimination rules on every enumerated profile, and candidate-relabeling orbits are checked exhaustively.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for complete strict ballots with four candidates and electorates through five voters. The comparison requires tie-independent unique Baldwin outcomes and Nanson singleton outcomes under strict-below-average elimination; no claim is made for arbitrary imposed tiebreak orders.
title: Sharp five-voter tie-independent divergence boundary for Nanson and Baldwin
